items.why_relevant: 本地跑284B模型，硬核技术突破

confirmed_facts.text: llama-modchip is a set of ggml/llama.cpp kernel patches, quantization transcoders, and runtime tools designed to run sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) checkpoints entirely in system RAM on x86_64 (AVX-512 / AVX2) and ARM64 (NEON / SVE / Apple Metal) processors: - Fitting 284B DeepS
